p: meat offering unto the LORD: Because the burnt offering could not be without the meat offering.
he shall take thereout his handful: The priest.
memorial of it upon the altar: To signify that God remembers him that offers.
most holy of the offerings of: Therefore no one could eat of it but the priest.
meat offering baken in a pan: Which is a gift offered to God to pacify him.
them unto the LORD: That is, fruits which were sweet as honey, ye may offer.
on the altar for a sweet: But reserved for the priests.
covenant of thy God to be: Which they were bound (as by covenant) to use all sacrifices, Nu 18:19; 2Ch 13:5; Eze 43:24 or it means a sure and pure covenant.
